description: This file declares classes, functions, and data structures related to static runtime execution in PyTorch JIT, including memory management, node processing, and execution modes.

classes.name: ValueGroup
classes.description: Classifies values in a graph into output aliases and external aliases for alias analysis.

classes.name: ManagedTensorRanges
classes.description: Tracks lifetimes and reuse of managed tensors within a graph.

classes.name: StaticModuleOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for static module compilation and execution.

classes.name: StaticRuntimeMetadata
classes.description: Attaches metadata to IR nodes for static runtime execution.

classes.name: BlockInfo
classes.description: Stores shared state and metadata for a graph block, including node info and value groups.

classes.name: StaticModule
classes.description: Represents a static, optimized version of a TorchScript graph or module for efficient execution.

classes.name: BlockRunner
classes.description: Core runtime executor for a graph block, managing memory, inputs, outputs, and node execution.

classes.name: StaticNodeInfo
classes.description: Stores preprocessed information about a node for static execution.

classes.name: ProcessedNode
classes.description: Represents a runtime-processed node with methods for execution and memory management.

classes.name: ProcessedNodeMetadata
classes.description: Holds metadata for a ProcessedNode, such as sub-blocks or task launchers.

classes.name: StaticRuntime
classes.description: Main class for executing a static module, managing shared IValues, and supporting async execution.

methods.name: canEnableStaticRuntime
methods.description: Checks if static runtime can be enabled for a given graph.

methods.name: dumpValueSet
methods.description: Serializes a set of values for debugging or analysis.

methods.name: StaticModule
methods.description: Constructs a static version of a graph or module for optimized execution.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Executes the static module with given inputs.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Performs asynchronous execution of a node or graph.

methods.name: check_for_memory_leak
methods.description: Checks for memory leaks in output tensors.

methods.name: benchmark
methods.description: Runs performance benchmarks on the static runtime.

methods.name: benchmark_individual_ops
methods.description: Benchmarks individual operations within the static runtime.
